events.title: 조나라에서 태어나다
events.title_en: Born in the state of Zhao
events.description: 조나라에서 태어났다. 태어난 해는 기록마다 갈려 기원전 298년 무렵으로 본다.
events.description_en: He was born in the state of Zhao. The records disagree on the year, and it is usually placed around 298 BC.

events.title: 제나라 직하학궁에서 학문을 닦다
events.title_en: He studied at the Jixia Academy in Qi
events.description: 제나라 직하학궁에 들어가 여러 학파의 학설을 두루 익혔다. 유가를 바탕으로 삼되 다른 학파의 논리도 받아들여 자기 사상을 세웠다.
events.description_en: He entered the Jixia Academy in Qi and studied the doctrines of many schools. He kept Confucianism as his base but took in the reasoning of other schools to build his own thought.

events.title: 직하학궁 좨주를 세 번 지내다
events.title_en: He served three times as libationer of the Jixia Academy
events.description: 직하학궁에서 가장 나이 많고 학식 높은 학자로 인정받아 좨주를 세 번 지냈다. 좨주는 학궁을 대표해 제사를 주관하는 자리였다.
events.description_en: Recognized at the Jixia Academy as its oldest and most learned scholar, he served three times as libationer, the post that led the academy's rites on its behalf.

events.title: 진나라를 살펴보다
events.title_en: He observed the state of Qin
events.description: 진나라로 가서 정치와 행정을 직접 살펴보았다. 관리들의 기강은 인정했지만 예와 유학자가 없다는 점을 비판하며 「강국편」에 그 소견을 남겼다.
events.description_en: He traveled to Qin and observed its government and administration firsthand. He acknowledged the discipline of its officials but criticized its lack of ritual and Confucian scholars, setting down his views in the chapter "Strengthening the State."

events.title: 춘신군에게 발탁되어 난릉령이 되다
events.title_en: Lord Chunshen appointed him magistrate of Lanling
events.description: 초나라 재상 춘신군이 그를 난릉의 현령으로 임명했다. 여든에 가까운 나이였다.
events.description_en: Lord Chunshen, chancellor of Chu, appointed him magistrate of Lanling. He was nearly eighty at the time.

events.title: 한비자와 이사를 제자로 두다
events.title_en: Han Feizi and Li Si studied under him
events.description: 한비자와 이사가 그의 문하에서 배웠다. 둘 다 훗날 법가 사상을 대표하는 인물이 되어 순자의 문하를 떠나 각자의 길로 갔다.
events.description_en: Han Feizi and Li Si both studied under him. Both later became leading figures of Legalist thought, moving on from his school to their own separate paths.

events.title: 춘신군이 죽자 난릉령에서 물러나다
events.title_en: He lost his post when Lord Chunshen was killed
events.description: 이원이 춘신군을 암살하자 그를 지켜 주던 힘도 함께 사라졌다. 그는 난릉령 자리에서 물러났다.
events.description_en: When Li Yuan assassinated Lord Chunshen, the power that had shielded him vanished with him. He was removed from the post of magistrate of Lanling.

events.title: 『순자』를 짓다
events.description: 성악설과 예를 통한 교화를 논하는 글들을 모아 『순자』를 지었다. 정확히 언제 썼는지는 알 수 없지만, 말년의 난릉 시절에 많은 편을 완성한 것으로 본다.
events.description_en: He gathered his essays on the evil nature of man and on reform through ritual into the Xunzi. When each piece was written is unclear, though many chapters are thought to have been finished in his later years at Lanling.

events.title: 난릉에서 죽다
events.description: 관직에서 물러난 뒤 오래지 않아 난릉에서 죽었다. 자신이 다스리던 그 땅에 묻혔다.
events.description_en: Not long after losing his post, he died in Lanling. He was buried in the land he had once governed.
